label: 画像生成

shape.name: woven-point-light-curtain
shape.description: Rectangular, gently saddle-curved light fabric made only of separate warp and weft samples with point-traced border bindings. The over-under offset suggests weaving without solid faces.
shape.topology: 28 warp traces, 22 weft traces, four point borders
shape.silhouette: A clear rectangular curtain with bowed depth and airy, regular weave.
shape.label: 縦横に織る光の幕

motion.phaseMeaning: Normalized Z height: phase 0 at the lower border →1 at the upper border. Both warp and weft share this phase so a coherent horizontal scan band crosses the fabric.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Send a narrow horizontal brightness band upward across both thread families, then optionally switch to a column scan derived from x. Do not turn the cloth into a filled plane or replace the dots with grid lines.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
